fact_english: Manila paper, the paper manila envelopes are made of, was originally made from Manila hemp, the Philippine fibre abaca.

lines.speaker: INDIO
lines.text: Ang manila paper, 'yung papel ng manila envelope, dati ay gawa sa manila hemp: ang abaka natin!

lines.speaker: USMAN
lines.text: Kaya pala kulay-abaka. Akala ko pagod lang ang papel.
